description: A state-of-the-art claim compared only to a weak baseline must be flagged.

inputs.label: Evaluation plan
inputs.content:
We evaluate FedSpec against FedAvg (McMahan et al., 2017) only.

Our related work section discusses FedProx, SCAFFOLD, MOON and FedDistill as the
standard approaches for non-IID federated learning, and notes that FedDistill is
the closest prior work to ours.

We claim FedSpec achieves state-of-the-art performance under label skew.

signals.name: connects the gap to the state-of-the-art claim
